title: Mailchimp Marketing API key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: "_" instead of the documented "-" before the us<N> data-center suffix; body and suffix unchanged. Twin of "Mailchimp Marketing API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
